description:
A borrower's open loans on GONDI, found by address, GONDI username or
ENS name; pass the name or address the user gives as `wallet`, no need
to resolve it first. Per loan: the NFT, principal in its currency and
in USD, APR, start and due date, days left, the repayment due at
expiry, whether it is in its end lockup, the pending renegotiation
offers on it and GONDI's best market loan offer on its NFT, each with
its net principal and its APR against the loan's. Answers "what are my
expiring loans?" (expiring_within_days, soonest due first;
matching_loan_count is how many are due in the window, whatever
`limit`) and "what should I renegotiate?" (sort_by REFINANCE_SAVING:
the loans a cheaper offer waits for first). open_loan_count is every
open loan of the wallet. `summary` counts and totals every matching
loan, not only the rows returned: principal and repayment per
currency, overdue and end-lockup counts, and loans and repayment per
due day. Answer "how many, how much, which days" from it, and to list
more loans call again with offset=next_offset; never send the user to
the site for the loans a page left out. To repay, accept a
renegotiation or refinance, send the user to the loan's gondi_url, its
NFT's page on GONDI.

expiring_within_days.description: Only the loans due within this many days, overdue ones included; every open loan if unset.
expiring_within_days.title: Expiring Within Days

offset.description: Skip this many loans of the sort: pass the previous answer's next_offset for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

sort_by.description: DUE_DATE: soonest due first. REFINANCE_SAVING: the largest APR cut on offer first, ranked over every matching loan up to the 300 soonest due (ranked_loan_count says how many).
sort_by.title: Sort By

wallet.description: The borrower: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

name: list_borrower_loans

BorrowerLoan.description:
One row per open loan, kept to what a borrower's questions read: a
wallet can hold hundreds, and every byte of a row is paid once per loan.
The NFT is named by its collection slug and token id, which
`get_nft_market` answers the contract address for; its chain is the one
`principal.currency_symbol` is lent on (`get_supported_markets`).

best_market_offer.description: The cheapest open loan offer on the NFT today in the loan's currency, which the borrower can refinance into: of GONDI's best-offer picks for each duration, the one with the lowest effective APR; null when there is none.

best_renegotiation_offer.description: The one with the lowest effective APR; null when there is none.

days_left.description: Until due_at; 0 once it passed, when the loan can no longer be repaid and its lenders can claim the NFT.
days_left.title: Days Left

in_end_lockup.description: In its last stretch, when lenders can no longer refinance it on their own: better terms then only come from the borrower accepting a renegotiation offer or refinancing into a market offer.
in_end_lockup.title: In End Lockup

refinance_apr_saving_percent.description: The larger APR reduction of the two offers above, negative when both cost more than the loan; null when there is neither.
refinance_apr_saving_percent.title: Refinance Apr Saving Percent

renegotiation_offer_count.description: Active public renegotiation offers lenders made on the loan, leaving out any with a zero term or a fee that takes its whole principal.
renegotiation_offer_count.title: Renegotiation Offer Count

repayment_at_expiry.description: The principal plus every interest due by due_at: the most repaying can cost.

BorrowerLoan.title: BorrowerLoan

BorrowerLoansSummary.description: Totals over every scanned loan, not only the `loans` returned.

due_days.description: Per day they come due, soonest first: the first 31 days that have a loan due; the totals above also count any later.
due_days.title: Due Days

loan_count.description: The loans summarized: matching_loan_count, or the 300 soonest due when the window holds more.
loan_count.title: Loan Count

overdue_loan_count.description: Past due_at and still open: no longer repayable.
overdue_loan_count.title: Overdue Loan Count

principal.description: Their total principal, one per currency.
principal.title: Principal

repayment_at_expiry.description: What repaying them all by expiry costs, one per currency.
repayment_at_expiry.title: Repayment At Expiry

BorrowerLoansSummary.title: BorrowerLoansSummary

loan_count.description: The summarized loans due that day.
loan_count.title: Loan Count

repayment_at_expiry.description: What repaying them all by expiry costs, one per currency.
repayment_at_expiry.title: Repayment At Expiry

amount_usd.description: At the current rate; null when the rate is unavailable.
amount_usd.title: Amount Usd

RefinanceOffer.description: Terms a lender offers in the loan's currency, next to the loan's own.

apr_reduction_percent.description: The loan's APR minus this offer's effective APR: positive when it is cheaper.
apr_reduction_percent.title: Apr Reduction Percent

effective_apr_percent.description: The APR with the origination fee prorated over the term: what the offer costs.
effective_apr_percent.title: Effective Apr Percent

net_principal.description: What the borrower receives, net of the origination fee, in whole tokens of the loan's currency: more than the loan's principal.amount when it lends more.
net_principal.title: Net Principal

RefinanceOffer.title: RefinanceOffer

matching_loan_count.description: The open loans due within expiring_within_days, or every open loan when it is unset: the exact total, even when `loans` holds only the first `limit` of them.
matching_loan_count.title: Matching Loan Count

next_offset.description: Pass as `offset` for the next page of loans; null on the last page, or past the 300 soonest due.
next_offset.title: Next Offset

open_loan_count.description: Every open loan of the wallet, whatever expiring_within_days.
open_loan_count.title: Open Loan Count

ranked_loan_count.description: With sort_by REFINANCE_SAVING, how many of the matching loans were ranked, the soonest due first; below matching_loan_count only when the wallet has more than the ranking's cap, so a larger saving can sit among the loans left out. Null under DUE_DATE.
ranked_loan_count.title: Ranked Loan Count

renegotiation_offer_counts_complete.description: False when the loans' NFTs held more active offers than one read returns, so a renegotiation count can fall short.
renegotiation_offer_counts_complete.title: Renegotiation Offer Counts Complete

wallet_address.description: The borrower the loans belong to.
wallet_address.title: Wallet Address

wallet_name.description: The name the address was resolved from; null when the call passed an address.
wallet_name.title: Wallet Name
